headline: Teodoro Rejects Beijing Criticism, Defends Philippine Law-Enforcement Actions
seoTitle: Teodoro Rejects Beijing Criticism Over Chinese-National Cases
seoDescription: Defense Secretary Gilberto Teodoro rejected Beijing's criticism and defended Philippine law-enforcement actions involving Chinese nationals.
deck: A disputed newsroom draft was corrected against current Reuters reporting before publication.
author: FMB News Desk

sections.heading: What happened
paragraphs: Reuters reported on August 15 that Defense Secretary Gilberto Teodoro rejected criticism from China's Foreign Ministry and called it a diversion from alleged illegal activities involving Chinese nationals in the Philippines.

The verified report places the cited steel-facility operation in Misamis Oriental and attributes the response to Teodoro. FMB News corrected the original email brief, which had attributed the statement to DND spokesperson Arsenio Andolong and placed the facility in Davao City.

sections.heading: Context
paragraphs: The article corrects two material errors in the email brief instead of reproducing them.

sections.heading: Why this matters
paragraphs: The exchange concerns Philippine law-enforcement sovereignty and an already strained bilateral relationship with China.

sections.heading: What to watch next
paragraphs: Watch for formal DFA exchanges, DND statements and any court or immigration proceedings tied to the cited enforcement cases.

sources.title: Philippine defence chief rejects China criticism, calls response a 'squid tactic'
